pairs.why: Both are desert scenes with a mesa, track and shrubs, but B adds extra rocks and a boulder, so A is slightly quieter.
B has a plain sea, horizon and one sand edge, while A adds a palm frond and sand at both ends, which makes it busier than the quiet real water and shore.
Both float the boot on a concentric-ring field with the same staging and load, so staging gives no reason to choose.
Both use a diamond wall pattern and a plain ledge with similar tone and load.
Both use concentric rings on a flat field with no props, and the ring contrast is about the same.
B's rings are quieter and more tone-on-tone like the real field, while A's bright magenta glow competes more with the fins.
B has five bulbs against A's six (real has four), and the two share the same planked wall and shelf brackets, so B is only slightly closer.
